flowRoot.flowPara: • When your Shadows copy a shadowstrike, they use that strikes range. For example, if you use a melee skill with shadowstrike, your Shadows can strike foes within melee range of themselves.
• When you end a shift into an enemy's square, you are automatically moved to the nearest open square - but it doesn't have to be the square you came from.
• The standard Traceless combo: from melee range, Displacer Strike to the other side of your foe, then play Gloom Edge. The Shadow created by Displacer Strike will copy both attacks!
• Blind gives an enemy's next basic strike a 25% chance to miss.
• Your Simulacrum minion lasts several turns. Use it early enough in the fight to get the most out of it.
• Mirage Jump not only creates a "free" shadow, it also allows you to swap squares with Shadows instead of consuming them.
• Tactical Disruption allows you to alter how foes attack. It can't prevent damage, but it can direct attacks at allies who have health to spare or defenses at the ready.
• Shadows aren't targetable and don't block movement or line of sight, but the Simulacrum minion is and does.
• Shadowstrikes copy only total damage (base and bonus damage); any additional effects of the attack aren't copied unless specifically noted.
• Phantom Dash causes you to shift twice if you trigger the secondary effect, thus creating two shadows.

• "Focuses" refers to certain encounter mechanics where a foe will "focus" on a player based on actions that player took or other conditionals. Tactical Disruption allows you to override those focuses as well as random targeted effects, allowing you to choose the targets. However,
